title: Daily digest: ICE detains Indian-origin man after visu | Bengaluru police launch crackdown on row | ‘Dhoni’s mentorship will help CSK’, says
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: ICE detains Indian-origin man after visual recording conviction.
Bengaluru police launch crackdown on rowdies after CM’s warning.
‘Dhoni’s mentorship will help CSK’, says Noor Ahmed.
bullets_ur: ICE ne visual recording saza ke baad Indian origin aadmi ko giraftar kar liya
Bengaluru police ne CM ke intebah ke baad rowdies par crackdown shuru kar diya
"Dhoni ki rehnumai CSK ke liye mufeed hogi", Noor Ahmed ne kaha.
